operation.summary: Read a body tracking session: its state and the frames since an index (each frame is the 33 points as [x, y, v, ...]: x and y fractions of the upright picture, v how sure the point is in view), plus the latest preview picture

query.name: since
query.description: First frame index to return (0 = from the start; pass the last reply's next)

query.name: preview_after
query.description: Include the preview picture when it is newer than this many ms into the session (-1 = the latest)

query.name: wait_ms
query.description: Wait up to this long (0-1000) for a new frame before answering

operation.returns: session_id, state starting|running|done|stopped|failed, camera, mirror, width_px, height_px, elapsed_ms, max_ms, analyzed, fps, frames_total, frames [{i, t ms, p [99 numbers]}], next, thumbs (replay pictures kept), points (the 33 names, when since=0), preview {t, width_px, height_px, data_base64} when asked and newer

preview_after.description: Include the preview picture when it is newer than this many ms into the session (-1 = the latest)

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long (0-1000) for a new frame before answering

since.description: First frame index to return (0 = from the start; pass the last reply's next)
